subject: Important Update: Changes to Company Policies
body: Dear team, I hope this message finds you well. I wanted to inform you about the recent changes to our company policies regarding remote work and attendance. Starting next month, we will be implementing a hybrid work model to better accommodate everyone's needs. Please review the updated policy document attached for more details. If you have any questions or concerns, feel free to reach out to HR. Thank you for your attention to this matter. Best regards, [Your Name]
